description: 歷史淹水資料 [flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本署河川局於中央氣象局發布豪大雨特報或颱風警報，倘轄區內降雨及積(淹)水達一定規模致發生淹水災害者，視災情自行啟動淹水災害調查，並由本署水利規劃試驗所彙整。 僅供本署分析歷次淹水災害致災事件、範圍，以利工程成效分析之參考。 本資料係屬大尺度之淹水調查。 局部、零星、都市道路或低漥農漁塭區淹積水範圍則不在調查範圍內。 本調查資料受限調查時間... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
